lessons.title: Leg, id, counter, capture
lessons.why: The same four questions work on a CUCM trunk and on a Connect flow.
paras: Which hop failed: carrier, flow, Lambda, queue, or softphone? Which ContactId joins the logs? Which counter moved: queue depth, concurrent calls, Lambda errors, or UDP failures? Which capture proves it: flow log, CTR, endpoint test, or a recording?
Change one thing. Retest that ContactId's scenario. Then stop.
points: A flow log error with no Lambda log is a permission or a payload rejection.
A CCP error that names TurnNlb is the network, even if the flow is perfect.
A fast busy on a campaign is the zero quota until proven otherwise.
A missing recording is the block, the bucket, or the key.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in one afternoon.

lessons.title: Audio quality is a path, not a codec myth
lessons.why: Connect's softphone does not ask you to pick G.711. The failures are path failures.
paras: The troubleshooting guide names firewalls, NAT, and VPNs first. Robotic audio, one-way audio, and mid-call drops belong to that list. Run the endpoint tool on the affected workstation. Compare a call on the office LAN with a call on the VPN.
After a Transfer to phone number, the other system owns the media. A clean CCP test and a bad external transfer means the far end, the carrier, or the PBX.
points: Stateless firewalls drop the return UDP.
VDI relocates the media.
A bad headset is still possible. Swap it after the network test, not before.
Packet captures are the capture step, not the first step.
lessons.mistake: Opening a carrier ticket for ice_collection_timeout.

lessons.title: A flow log you can actually search
lessons.why: The query is short. The discipline is saving the ContactId before you hang up the test phone.
paras: Search for Error, for the block name, and for the ContactId. InvokeExternalResource is the Lambda block in the log. AccessDenied, timeout, and a response-shape failure look different if you read the Results field.
If the customer says the call died at the menu, you want the last block, not the first error you have ever seen in the log group.
points: Turn logging on in a module if every flow should log.
Retention of the log group is your setting.
PII in attributes will land in the log. Do not log secrets.
A successful block with a wrong branch is not an error. Read the attributes.
lessons.mistake: Filtering the last hour of all errors and 'fixing' an unrelated contact.

number.n: Put it in the query first

lessons.title: Faults worth memorizing
lessons.why: A short list beats a wiki nobody opens during an incident.
paras: Softphone text that names TurnNlb is UDP 3478 or DNS. Lambda AccessDenied is the resource policy or the association. A 10-second function with an 8-second block is a timeout even when Lambda 'succeeded'. Campaign fast busy is the zero quota. The first phone-number claim can fail at quota zero-looking errors that need Support.
Voice ID faults after 20 May 2026 are expected. Remove the blocks. Email threads split at 90 days. Idle chats fill the 500.
points: SAML users with no routing profile signed in and cannot take work.
Global Resiliency numbers missing from the replica were never in a distribution group.
A recording missing from S3 is policy, key, or the block.
CTR delay under five minutes is buffering. Past that, check Firehose errors.
lessons.mistake: One runbook called 'call quality' that includes Lambda timeouts.

lessons.title: Failed to establish softphone connection
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the softphone hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The browser cannot open media to the Regional TurnNlb endpoint. The capture that settles it is Endpoint Connectivity tool.

Change one thing: Allow outbound UDP 3478 to TurnNlb in the instance Region and rerun the Endpoint Connectivity tool on that PC. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Softphone.
Cause: The browser cannot open media to the Regional TurnNlb endpoint.
Fix: Allow outbound UDP 3478 to TurnNlb in the instance Region and rerun the Endpoint Connectivity tool on that PC.
Capture: Endpoint Connectivity tool.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: ice_collection_timeout
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the browser hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: ICE candidate collection timed out before a media channel existed. The capture that settles it is CCP error text.
Change one thing: Check DNS for TurnNlb, UDP 3478, and any VPN or proxy on the media path. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Browser.
Cause: ICE candidate collection timed out before a media channel existed.
Fix: Check DNS for TurnNlb, UDP 3478, and any VPN or proxy on the media path.
Capture: CCP error text.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

diagram.caption: ice_collection_timeout

flow.label: Fix
flow.detail: Check DNS for TurnNlb, UDP 3478, and any VPN or proxy on the media path.

lessons.title: One-way audio
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the media path hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Signaling is up and media is not, usually NAT or a stateless firewall. The capture that settles it is Compare VPN on and off.
Change one thing: Allow the browser ephemeral UDP range back in. Take the VPN off the media path. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Media path.
Cause: Signaling is up and media is not, usually NAT or a stateless firewall.
Fix: Allow the browser ephemeral UDP range back in. Take the VPN off the media path.
Capture: Compare VPN on and off.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Lambda AccessDenied in the flow log
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the invoke hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Connect could not invoke the function. The Lambda log is empty. The capture that settles it is Flow log Results field.

Change one thing: Associate the function with the instance and allow principal connect.amazonaws.com to invoke that alias. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Invoke.
Cause: Connect could not invoke the function. The Lambda log is empty.
Fix: Associate the function with the instance and allow principal connect.amazonaws.com to invoke that alias.
Capture: Flow log Results field.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Lambda runs longer than the block waits
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the lambda hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: A synchronous block waits at most 8 seconds, even if the function timeout is longer. The capture that settles it is Duration beside the block timeout.
Change one thing: Return inside 8 seconds, or switch the block to asynchronous and play a prompt. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Lambda.
Cause: A synchronous block waits at most 8 seconds, even if the function timeout is longer.
Fix: Return inside 8 seconds, or switch the block to asynchronous and play a prompt.
Capture: Duration beside the block timeout.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Response is not a string map
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the return shape hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The block expected a flat object of strings and received nested JSON or a large payload. The capture that settles it is The returned JSON.
Change one thing: Match the block's response validation. Keep the payload small. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Return shape.
Cause: The block expected a flat object of strings and received nested JSON or a large payload.
Fix: Match the block's response validation. Keep the payload small.
Capture: The returned JSON.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: You've reached the limit of Phone Numbers
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the telephony quota hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The first claim can show this message even when the instance has zero numbers. The capture that settles it is The console message.
Change one thing: Open a Support case. Do not keep clicking claim. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Telephony quota.
Cause: The first claim can show this message even when the instance has zero numbers.
Fix: Open a Support case. Do not keep clicking claim.
Capture: The console message.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Fast busy on a campaign call
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the campaign quota hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Concurrent campaign calls default to 0. The capture that settles it is Applied quota value.
Change one thing: Raise the campaign concurrency quota before the run. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Campaign quota.
Cause: Concurrent campaign calls default to 0.
Fix: Raise the campaign concurrency quota before the run.
Capture: Applied quota value.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Chat starts fail while agents look idle
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the chat quota hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Idle chats still count toward the concurrent chat quota of 500. The capture that settles it is Concurrent chats metric.
Change one thing: Close or persist idle chats, and alarm at 80 percent. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Chat quota.
Cause: Idle chats still count toward the concurrent chat quota of 500.
Fix: Close or persist idle chats, and alarm at 80 percent.
Capture: Concurrent chats metric.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Recording missing from S3
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the storage hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The recording block was off, or the bucket policy or KMS key policy rejected the write. The capture that settles it is Recording.Location on the CTR.
Change one thing: Confirm the block, the storage config, and the key policy, then place one new test call. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Storage.
Cause: The recording block was off, or the bucket policy or KMS key policy rejected the write.
Fix: Confirm the block, the storage config, and the key policy, then place one new test call.
Capture: Recording.Location on the CTR.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

flow.label: Fix
flow.detail: Confirm the block, the storage config, and the key policy, then place one new test call.

lessons.title: CTR missing after one minute
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the ctr delivery hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Firehose buffers. Five quiet minutes is the point to inspect errors. The capture that settles it is Firehose error objects.
Change one thing: Check the delivery-stream error prefix and the S3 destination. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: CTR delivery.
Cause: Firehose buffers. Five quiet minutes is the point to inspect errors.
Fix: Check the delivery-stream error prefix and the S3 destination.
Capture: Firehose error objects.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

diagram.caption: CTR missing after one minute

flow.label: Fix
flow.detail: Check the delivery-stream error prefix and the S3 destination.

lessons.title: SAML user has no routing profile
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the identity hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The assertion did not map a role, security profile, and routing profile the instance accepts. The capture that settles it is IdP assertion and the user profile.
Change one thing: Fix one user, place one test call, then federate the group. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Identity.
Cause: The assertion did not map a role, security profile, and routing profile the instance accepts.
Fix: Fix one user, place one test call, then federate the group.
Capture: IdP assertion and the user profile.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Caller hangs up on an error with no prompt
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the flow hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: An error output is not connected, so Connect ends the contact. The capture that settles it is Last block in the flow log.
Change one thing: Connect every error, timeout, and default branch. Turn logging on first. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Flow.
Cause: An error output is not connected, so Connect ends the contact.
Fix: Connect every error, timeout, and default branch. Turn logging on first.
Capture: Last block in the flow log.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Transfer to queue does nothing useful
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the flow order hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Set working queue was skipped, or it sits after the transfer. The capture that settles it is Flow log block order.
Change one thing: Set the queue, then transfer. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Flow order.
Cause: Set working queue was skipped, or it sits after the transfer.
Fix: Set the queue, then transfer.
Capture: Flow log block order.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: The overflow team takes every call
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the routing hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Their queue is priority 1 or their delay is 0. The capture that settles it is Profile priority and delay.

Change one thing: Give primary agents the lower priority number and a delay of 0. Give overflow a higher number and a delay. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Routing.
Cause: Their queue is priority 1 or their delay is 0.
Fix: Give primary agents the lower priority number and a delay of 0. Give overflow a higher number and a delay.
Capture: Profile priority and delay.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Replica Region has no numbers
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the resiliency hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Numbers were not in a traffic distribution group. Osaka only fully replicates numbers enabled for Global Resiliency. The capture that settles it is Which Region answered.
Change one thing: Associate the numbers, then place a call after a 10 percent shift. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Resiliency.
Cause: Numbers were not in a traffic distribution group. Osaka only fully replicates numbers enabled for Global Resiliency.
Fix: Associate the numbers, then place a call after a 10 percent shift.
Capture: Which Region answered.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

flow.label: Fix
flow.detail: Associate the numbers, then place a call after a 10 percent shift.

lessons.title: Custom CCP loads and audio never starts
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the streams hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: amazon-connect-streams can run media-less. Media still needs the softphone allow list. The capture that settles it is Init options and the endpoint tool.
Change one thing: Initialize with softphone options and test UDP 3478. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Streams.
Cause: amazon-connect-streams can run media-less. Media still needs the softphone allow list.
Fix: Initialize with softphone options and test UDP 3478.
Capture: Init options and the endpoint tool.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Error rate above 2 percent on the domain allow list
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the proxy hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: A proxy cannot resolve the WebSocket or TURN domains. The capture that settles it is Error rate over 200 calls.
Change one thing: Test more than 200 calls. Review proxy DNS if the error rate stays above 2 percent. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Proxy.
Cause: A proxy cannot resolve the WebSocket or TURN domains.
Fix: Test more than 200 calls. Review proxy DNS if the error rate stays above 2 percent.
Capture: Error rate over 200 calls.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: An email reply became a new contact
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the email hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Replies after 90 days start a new thread. The capture that settles it is Thread age.

Change one thing: Expect a new thread on day 91. Set contact expiry on purpose if you need longer than 14 days, never past 90. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Email.
Cause: Replies after 90 days start a new thread.
Fix: Expect a new thread on day 91. Set contact expiry on purpose if you need longer than 14 days, never past 90.
Capture: Thread age.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Voice ID block fails in a 2026 flow
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the flow hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Support ended 20 May 2026. New customers stopped 20 May 2025. The capture that settles it is Block type in the flow JSON.
Change one thing: Remove the Voice ID blocks. Use a partner or a one-time password. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Flow.
Cause: Support ended 20 May 2026. New customers stopped 20 May 2025.
Fix: Remove the Voice ID blocks. Use a partner or a one-time password.
Capture: Block type in the flow JSON.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: TurnNlb does not resolve
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the dns hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The workstation DNS cannot answer the Regional TURN name, so ICE never gathers candidates. The capture that settles it is nslookup of the TURN name.
Change one thing: Resolve the TurnNlb name from the agent PC, not from a jump host. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: DNS.
Cause: The workstation DNS cannot answer the Regional TURN name, so ICE never gathers candidates.
Fix: Resolve the TurnNlb name from the agent PC, not from a jump host.
Capture: nslookup of the TURN name.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

diagram.caption: TurnNlb does not resolve

flow.label: Fix
flow.detail: Resolve the TurnNlb name from the agent PC, not from a jump host.

lessons.title: CCP shows available and the microphone is blocked
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the browser permission hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The browser never received microphone permission, so the softphone cannot capture audio. The capture that settles it is Site permission for the microphone.
Change one thing: Allow the microphone for the instance origin and reload the CCP. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Browser permission.
Cause: The browser never received microphone permission, so the softphone cannot capture audio.
Fix: Allow the microphone for the instance origin and reload the CCP.
Capture: Site permission for the microphone.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Midnight callers reach a closed queue that the prompt calls open
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the hours hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Check hours uses the queue time zone. The tester's laptop zone is irrelevant. The capture that settles it is Queue time zone and the branch taken.
Change one thing: Read the hours object zone and today's override before editing the prompt. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Hours.
Cause: Check hours uses the queue time zone. The tester's laptop zone is irrelevant.
Fix: Read the hours object zone and today's override before editing the prompt.
Capture: Queue time zone and the branch taken.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: A holiday still follows the weekly hours
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the override hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The override does not include that date, or the quota of 50 overrides hid the one you needed. The capture that settles it is Override list for that date.
Change one thing: Open the override for the date and place a test call that the log shows as out of hours. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Override.
Cause: The override does not include that date, or the quota of 50 overrides hid the one you needed.
Fix: Open the override for the date and place a test call that the log shows as out of hours.
Capture: Override list for that date.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Lex works in its console and errors on the call
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the lex hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The bot alias is not associated with the instance, or the block selects a different alias. The capture that settles it is Alias association and the error branch.
Change one thing: Associate the alias, select it on Get customer input, and test speech and DTMF. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Lex.
Cause: The bot alias is not associated with the instance, or the block selects a different alias.
Fix: Associate the alias, select it on Get customer input, and test speech and DTMF.
Capture: Alias association and the error branch.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: The chat widget does not start
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the chat widget hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The page origin is not allowed for the widget. The capture that settles it is Page origin against the allow list.
Change one thing: Add the origin, then start one chat and read the browser console for the blocked frame. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Chat widget.
Cause: The page origin is not allowed for the widget.
Fix: Add the origin, then start one chat and read the browser console for the blocked frame.
Capture: Page origin against the allow list.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: The CUCM agent has a blank screen pop
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the transfer hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Transfer to phone number leaves Connect. Attributes do not ride the PSTN. The capture that settles it is Attributes present before the transfer.
Change one thing: Pop before the transfer, or keep the second leg inside Connect. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Transfer.
Cause: Transfer to phone number leaves Connect. Attributes do not ride the PSTN.
Fix: Pop before the transfer, or keep the second leg inside Connect.
Capture: Attributes present before the transfer.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Salesforce pops the wrong person
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the screen pop hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The match used ANI on a number shared by a household. The capture that settles it is Attribute name in the flow and in the layout.
Change one thing: Match the account id collected in the flow, and write that attribute before the queue. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Screen pop.
Cause: The match used ANI on a number shared by a household.
Fix: Match the account id collected in the flow, and write that attribute before the queue.
Capture: Attribute name in the flow and in the layout.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: WFM adherence is blank on day one
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the wfm hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Agent events are missing, statuses are unmapped, or the schedule was never published. The capture that settles it is One agent event and the schedule state.
Change one thing: Confirm one status-change event, the status map, and a published schedule. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: WFM.
Cause: Agent events are missing, statuses are unmapped, or the schedule was never published.
Fix: Confirm one status-change event, the status map, and a published schedule.
Capture: One agent event and the schedule state.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Analytics search returns nothing for a known call
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the analytics hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The recording and analytics block never ran, or the post-contact job is still working. The capture that settles it is Whether the block ran.
Change one thing: Enable the block, place a call that says a known phrase, then search. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Analytics.
Cause: The recording and analytics block never ran, or the post-contact job is still working.
Fix: Enable the block, place a call that says a known phrase, then search.
Capture: Whether the block ran.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: A home agent's 911 address is the headquarters
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the e911 hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The stored profile address was never updated when the agent left the office. The capture that settles it is 933 readback.
Change one thing: Validate the current address, store it on that agent's profile, and test with 933. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: E911.
Cause: The stored profile address was never updated when the agent left the office.
Fix: Validate the current address, store it on that agent's profile, and test with 933.
Capture: 933 readback.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: The second WFM consumer is minutes behind
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the kinesis hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: One Kinesis shard is serving two consumers. The capture that settles it is Iterator age.
Change one thing: Give each consumer its own iterator and add shards when iterator age grows. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Kinesis.
Cause: One Kinesis shard is serving two consumers.
Fix: Give each consumer its own iterator and add shards when iterator age grows.
Capture: Iterator age.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Outbound calls fail or show the wrong number
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the outbound hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The queue caller ID is empty or is a number you may not present. The capture that settles it is Queue caller ID.
Change one thing: Set a claimed number the queue is allowed to present, then place one outbound call. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Outbound.
Cause: The queue caller ID is empty or is a number you may not present.
Fix: Set a claimed number the queue is allowed to present, then place one outbound call.
Capture: Queue caller ID.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Callbacks sit forever
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the callback hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The callback entered a queue that no routing profile staffs. The capture that settles it is Queue staffed count.
Change one thing: Put the queue on a profile with agents in Available, then watch one callback connect. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Callback.
Cause: The callback entered a queue that no routing profile staffs.
Fix: Put the queue on a profile with agents in Available, then watch one callback connect.
Capture: Queue staffed count.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

diagram.caption: Callbacks sit forever

flow.label: Fix
flow.detail: Put the queue on a profile with agents in Available, then watch one callback connect.

lessons.title: A failed ContactId has no flow log
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the logs hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Set logging behavior is off, or a later block turned it off. The capture that settles it is Log group for that ContactId.
Change one thing: Turn logging on in a module every flow invokes, then repeat the test. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Logs.
Cause: Set logging behavior is off, or a later block turned it off.
Fix: Turn logging on in a module every flow invokes, then repeat the test.
Capture: Log group for that ContactId.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Failover flows take the Lambda error branch
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the replica hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The function exists in the source Region only. The capture that settles it is Invoke in each Region.
Change one thing: Deploy the same alias in the replica Region and associate it before the drill. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Replica.
Cause: The function exists in the source Region only.
Fix: Deploy the same alias in the replica Region and associate it before the drill.
Capture: Invoke in each Region.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Failover plays silence where a prompt should be
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the prompts hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: A prompt that lives only as an object you uploaded is not fully replicated the way built-in prompts are. The capture that settles it is Prompt playback in both Regions.
Change one thing: Re-test every custom prompt in the replica and keep the file in the pipeline. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Prompts.
Cause: A prompt that lives only as an object you uploaded is not fully replicated the way built-in prompts are.
Fix: Re-test every custom prompt in the replica and keep the file in the pipeline.
Capture: Prompt playback in both Regions.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: New tasks will not route
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the tasks hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: Active tasks include after-contact work, and the 2500 concurrent quota is full of ACW. The capture that settles it is Concurrent tasks including ACW.
Change one thing: Finish or expire ACW, and alarm on concurrent tasks. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Tasks.
Cause: Active tasks include after-contact work, and the 2500 concurrent quota is full of ACW.
Fix: Finish or expire ACW, and alarm on concurrent tasks.
Capture: Concurrent tasks including ACW.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

diagram.caption: New tasks will not route

flow.label: Fix
flow.detail: Finish or expire ACW, and alarm on concurrent tasks.

lessons.title: Every agent can play every recording
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the access hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: The security profile grants recording access to the agent role. The capture that settles it is Security profile permissions.
Change one thing: Split a listener profile from the agent profile and retest with an agent login. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Access.
Cause: The security profile grants recording access to the agent role.
Fix: Split a listener profile from the agent profile and retest with an agent login.
Capture: Security profile permissions.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.

lessons.title: Distribute by percentage is being used as skills routing
lessons.why: This fault shows up at the routing hop. Naming it stops a team from editing the flow when the failure is elsewhere.
paras: That block sends a share of contacts down a branch. It does not look at proficiency. The capture that settles it is Which block is splitting traffic.
Change one thing: Use routing criteria or profile priority. Keep percentage for a measured pilot only. Then repeat the same scenario and compare the new ContactId with the old one.
points: Hop: Routing.
Cause: That block sends a share of contacts down a branch. It does not look at proficiency.
Fix: Use routing criteria or profile priority. Keep percentage for a measured pilot only.
Capture: Which block is splitting traffic.
lessons.mistake: Changing the flow, the Lambda, and the firewall in the same hour.
